messages.subject: Approved Org Changes - Effective April 14
messages.body_plain:
Hi team,

The following reporting changes are approved and effective immediately:

1. Aisha Jordan -> moves from Lisa Wang to Marcus Chen
2. Bo Lindqvist -> moves from Marcus Chen to Derek Huang
3. Chiara Russo -> moves from Derek Huang to Lisa Wang
